messages:
ajay: quick Q on per-route quotas — are user-specific quotas evaluated before or after route buckets? hitting 429s on /v1/generate after long idle bursts. cc @maria @keith

maria: we evaluate route buckets first, then global, then user. Why are you seeing 429s?

ajay: logs show 429s with headers: Retry-After: 60 and x-rate-limit-reset: 1776550200, but some 429s come back with no x-rate-limit-* headers at all.

keith: did you catch the proxy consolidation deploy last week? it merged similar routes into a single bucket for smoother utilization — might be side-effect.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for proxy v1.3.2 at 1776500000 :tada:

maria: short answer — headers must always be present (x-rate-limit-limit, x-rate-limit-remaining, x-rate-limit-reset) and Retry-After when applicable. Missing headers = bug.

ajay: semantics question: Retry-After should be integer seconds, right? docs say seconds but saw a float '1.5' once.

keith: should be integer seconds. downstream timing lib probably returned fractional secs. i'll open an issue to normalize to Math.ceil(seconds).

ajay: also curious about burst policy differences hosted vs dedicated. customers expect short spikes to be accepted.

maria: hosted uses token-bucket with burst_size = 2x baseline by default. Dedicated defers to contract-configured burst policy. if burst consumed we return 429 and can fallback to a lower-cost model variant when configured.

ajay: expected 429 body shape for clients: something like {"error":"rate_limited","route":"/v1/generate","remaining":0,"retry_after":60}?

keith: we purposely avoid leaking internal bucket ids. canonical body should include quota_type and remaining. example we want: {"error":"rate_limited","quota_type":"route","remaining":0,"retry_after":60}. headers mirror these as x-rate-limit-remaining and x-rate-limit-reset.

ajay: can we standardize to always mirror key fields in both headers and body? some SDKs only read JSON body.

maria: yes — plan: headers always present; body mirrors critical fields. i'm adding this to the API contract PR.

ajay: pinging code-review: @taylor can you review PR that adds header mirroring + integer rounding for Retry-After? https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1234

taylor: :eyes: will review today. quick question — do we need a backward-compat toggle? some private customers rely on old header shape.

maria: add feature-flag 'strict-429-headers' default ON for hosted, OFF for private until we rollout. update docs & changelog accordingly.

keith: FYI per-route cooldown is a sliding window of 60s. burst smoothing adds a cooldown-extension that doubles on consecutive 429s (to penalize repeated bursts). we should document this for SRE/customer expectations.

ajay: makes sense. one more: clients saw missing headers only in a time window — could this be proxy swallowing headers when backend errors? @devops-jen can you check NGINX logs for /v1/generate between 1776549000-1776550000?

devops-jen: on it, will post findings shortly.

(devops-jen posted later)
devops-jen: quick follow-up: found a proxy path where upstream returned 502 and we proxied a synthetic 429 for some edge cases; headers got dropped when we composed the synthetic body. patch ready to ensure header pass-through and explicit header set for synthetic responses. snippet: ```nginx
proxy_intercept_errors on;
error_page 502 = @synth_rate;
location @synth_rate {
  add_header X-Rate-Limit-Limit 1000;
  add_header X-Rate-Limit-Remaining 0;
  add_header X-Rate-Limit-Reset $upstream_http_x_rate_limit_reset;
  return 429 '{"error":"rate_limited","quota_type":"route","remaining":0,"retry_after":60}';
}
```

maria: perfect — please include unit tests that assert headers are present for synthetic/error responses. i'll add e2e test to contract tests too.

ajay: thanks. once PR merged can we add an integration test that asserts header/body parity for JS/Python SDKs? simple curl example for docs: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
# expect headers: X-Rate-Limit-Remaining, X-Rate-Limit-Reset and body keys retry_after/remaining
```

maria: added to the PR checklist. i'll also update /docs/rate-limits.md with explicit header examples, integer semantics, and feature-flag notes.

keith: filed issue #452 to normalize Retry-After rounding and #453 for header parity tests.

ajay: awesome, thanks all. cc @taylor for review once ready. :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop — i'll push the API contract updates and changelog entry after we merge devops patch. expected timeline: today/tomorrow.
